model_architecture: Two-base-model stack: LightGBM GBDT + CatBoostClassifier, blended via LogisticRegression meta on validation probabilities
data_representation: Re-use the fixed combined molecular feature pipeline from iteration 9/13: for each SMILES produce concatenated features in this order: (1) ECFP (Morgan) radius=2, 2048-bit binary; (2) Morgan count radius=2, 2048 length; (3) Morgan count radius=3, 2048 length; (4) MACCS keys 167-bit; (5) RDKit 2D descriptors. Handle invalid SMILES by zeroing fingerprint/MACCS blocks and imputing/scaling zeros for descriptors. Fit a median imputer on the descriptor block using the training set only, then StandardScaler (with mean/std from train); save descriptor_stats (median/mean/std) and reuse unchanged for validation/test/inference. Ensure identical feature order and preprocessing across train/val/test/inference.

model_architecture: Stacking ensemble with three base learners + logistic regression meta-learner on combined molecular features (ECFP2048 bin r2, Morgan count r2 2048, Morgan count r3 2048, MACCS167, RDKit 2D descriptors with median impute+standardize). Base models: CatBoostClassifier GPU Logloss; LightGBM GBDT; XGBoost hist; meta LogisticRegression.
data_representation: Re-use combined molecular feature pipeline from iteration 13 (combine_features.py): for each SMILES, compute and concatenate in order: (1) ECFP (Morgan fingerprint) radius 2, 2048-bit binary; (2) Morgan count fingerprint radius 2, 2048-length counts; (3) Morgan count fingerprint radius 3, 2048-length counts; (4) MACCS 167-bit keys; (5) RDKit 2D descriptors. Fit a median imputer plus StandardScaler on the RDKit descriptor block using training data only; save stats to descriptor_stats.json. For invalid SMILES, set fingerprint and MACCS blocks to zeros and descriptor block to imputed+scaled zeros. Keep feature order fixed across train/val/inference. The final feature vector is the concatenation of these blocks, with descriptors imputed and standardized, others kept as-is (binary/counts).

model_architecture: CatBoostClassifier on merged classical features + MolFormer CLS embeddings
data_representation: Classical features regenerated with combine_features.py (ECFP2 2048 bits + Morgan count r2 2048 + Morgan count r3 2048 + MACCS 167 + RDKit 2D descriptors with train-fitted median imputer and StandardScaler). Saved as combined_train.npz / combined_val.npz with descriptor_stats.json. MolFormer embedding script created (molformer_embeddings.py) to compute CLS embeddings (max_length=256, padding=max_length, truncation, batch_size 32, GPU, trust_remote_code) saved to train_emb.npy/val_emb.npy. Merging script (build_merged_features.py) concatenates classical features with MolFormer embeddings, output merged_train.npz / merged_val.npz and merged_feature_info.json documenting feature order and dimensions.

model_architecture: Fixed-weight two-model ensemble: average of probability_1 outputs (0.5 each) from pretrained CatBoost classifier (iteration 13, combined molecular features) and pretrained XGBoost classifier (iteration 9, combined molecular features). Shared featurization: concatenated [ECFP radius 2 (2048-bit binary), Morgan count radius 2 (2048), Morgan count radius 3 (2048), MACCS 167-bit, RDKit 2D descriptors standardized with per-model descriptor_stats.json]. No new base model training, no weight fitting.
data_representation: Reuse combined molecular featurization from iteration 13: concatenate in order [ECFP radius 2 (2048-bit binary), Morgan count radius 2 (2048), Morgan count radius 3 (2048), MACCS 167-bit], plus RDKit 2D descriptors with median imputation and StandardScaler using precomputed stats. No refit; load per-model descriptor_stats.json and apply identical transformation for that model.

model_architecture: Ensemble of CatBoostClassifier (GPU, Logloss/AUC) and LightGBM DART; both consume combined dense features (ECFP2 2048 bits, Morgan count r2 2048, Morgan count r3 2048, MACCS 167, RDKit 2D descriptors with imputer+scaler). Weighted average ensemble of their probability outputs with tuned weight on validation.
data_representation: Use combined molecular feature pipeline from iteration 13/15: for each SMILES (column `Drug`), generate and concatenate in fixed order: (1) ECFP radius 2, 2048-bit binary fingerprint (Morgan bits); (2) Morgan count fingerprint radius 2, 2048 length; (3) Morgan count fingerprint radius 3, 2048 length; (4) MACCS keys, 167-bit binary; (5) RDKit 2D descriptors. For invalid SMILES, set fingerprint and MACCS vectors to zeros; descriptors to zeros then imputed/scaled. Fit a median imputer + StandardScaler on the descriptor block using the train split only, store median/mean/std in descriptor_stats.json. Apply the same imputation and scaling to train, validation, and inference. Concatenate all blocks into a dense feature vector; no further normalization on fingerprints/MACCS. Save and reuse combine_features.py implementing this pipeline.

model_architecture: Stacking ensemble with four base learners on cheminformatics and merged features plus logistic regression meta-learner
data_representation: Concatenate classical cheminformatics features with transformer embeddings. Classical block (from combine_features.py, fitted on train only): ECFP radius2 2048-bit binary; Morgan count radius2 2048; Morgan count radius3 2048; MACCS 167-bit; RDKit 2D descriptors imputed by median (train-fit) then StandardScaler (train-fit). Save descriptor_stats.json for imputer/scaler params. Transformer block: MolFormer CLS embeddings (max_length=256, padding=max_length, truncation, batch_size=32, GPU if available). If train_emb.npy/val_emb.npy exist from iteration 17, reuse; otherwise regenerate via molformer_embeddings.py. Merge features by concatenating classical followed by MolFormer embeddings (same ordering as iteration 17 build_merged_features.py) and save merged_train.npz / merged_val.npz with feature info.

model_architecture: Ensemble of three models: (1) CatBoostClassifier on classical features; (2) XGBoostClassifier on classical features; (3) CatBoostClassifier on merged classical + MolFormer embeddings. Final prediction via weighted average of the three models’ probabilities.
data_representation: Reuse classical + MolFormer combined pipeline from previous iterations. Classical block: concatenate ECFP (radius 2, 2048-bit binary), Morgan count fingerprints radius 2 (2048 counts), Morgan count radius 3 (2048 counts), MACCS 167-bit keys, and RDKit 2D descriptors. Fit median imputer and StandardScaler on the descriptor subset using train descriptors only; persist stats in descriptor_stats.json. MolFormer embeddings: CLS token embeddings with max_length=256, padding=max_length, truncation, batch size 32, GPU if available. If cached train_emb.npy and val_emb.npy exist, reuse; otherwise generate via molformer_embeddings.py. Merged feature matrices are built by concatenating the fully processed classical block (post-scaling descriptors) followed by MolFormer embeddings, saved as merged_train.npz and merged_val.npz with merged_feature_info.json documenting ordering and dimensions.

model_architecture: AutoModelForSequenceClassification (ibm-research/MoLFormer-XL-both-10pct), unfrozen encoder, dropout default ~0.1, id2label {0:'nonblocker',1:'blocker'}
data_representation: On-the-fly SMILES tokenization with AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('ibm-research/MoLFormer-XL- both-10pct'), using parameters: max_length=256, padding='max_length', truncation=True, return_attention_mask=True. Tokenization is applied dynamically during training, validation, and inference (no cached features). Labels: binary {0:'nonblocker', 1:'blocker'}. No additional feature engineering; model consumes token ids and attention masks directly.

model_architecture: AutoModelForSequenceClassification from 'ibm-research/MoLFormer-XL-both-10pct' (trust_remote_code=True), num_labels=2, id2label={0:'nonblocker',1:'blocker'}, label2id inverse, full encoder unfrozen, default dropout, classification head trained from scratch.
data_representation: On-the-fly SMILES tokenization with augmentation for training only. A custom Torch Dataset stores canonical SMILES and labels. In __getitem__ for training, parse SMILES with RDKit; if parsing succeeds, generate a randomized SMILES via Chem.MolToSmiles(mol, doRandom=True, canonical=False); if parsing fails, fall back to canonical SMILES. For validation, always use canonical SMILES (deterministic). Tokenize each SMILES using AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('ibm-research/MoLFormer- XL-both-10pct', trust_remote_code=True) with max_length=256, padding='max_length', truncation=True. Do not cache features; tokenization happens per batch. Dataset returns tokenized input_ids and attention_mask plus label.

model_architecture: Stacked ensemble: Base learners = CatBoostClassifier (GPU if available) on combined molecular features; LightGBM DART on combined molecular features. Meta-learner = LogisticRegression (L2) on 2-D OOF base probabilities.
data_representation: Use combined fixed-order molecular features (from iteration 19 combine_features.py): concatenate (1) ECFP radius=2, 2048-bit binary fingerprint; (2) Morgan count radius=2, 2048-d counts; (3) Morgan count radius=3, 2048-d counts; (4) MACCS keys 167-bit binary; (5) RDKit 2D descriptors block. Fit median imputer and StandardScaler on the training descriptor block only; save stats to descriptor_stats.json. During feature build: compute fingerprints/MACCS for valid SMILES; for invalid SMILES use zeros for all fingerprint/MACCS bits and imputed/scaled zeros for descriptors. Apply the same descriptor imputation and scaling to train/val/test using saved stats. Keep exact feature order across all splits and inference.

model_architecture: Weighted probability ensemble of three pretrained tabular models over on-the-fly concatenated chem features (ECFP2 2048-bit, Morgan count r2 2048, Morgan count r3 2048, MACCS 167, RDKit 2D descriptors), each with its own median-imputer+StandardScaler stats: (1) LightGBM binary classifier (hist) from iter11; (2) CatBoostClassifier from iter13; (3) XGBoost binary classifier from iter9. Ensemble output = w1*p_lgbm + w2*p_cat + w3*p_xgb, w_i≥0, Σw_i=1 selected via validation ROC-AUC grid search (step 0.05).
data_representation: Use on-the-fly concatenated molecular features per model via combine_features.py logic (from iteration 19/25): ECFP radius2 2048-bit binary, Morgan count radius2 2048 counts, Morgan count radius3 2048 counts, MACCS 167-bit, and RDKit 2D descriptors. For each pretrained model, load its own descriptor_stats.json (median values and scaler parameters). Compute fingerprints/descriptors from the Drug SMILES; invalid SMILES -> zero fingerprints/MACCS and descriptors filled with imputed+scaled zeros. Apply median imputation then StandardScaler using that model’s stats to the descriptor block; concatenate in fixed order. No new caches; features computed on-the-fly for train/validation/test per model. Weighted ensemble uses the three models’ respective feature pipelines with their stats to produce probabilities and combine them.

model_architecture: Weighted-average ensemble of two fixed pretrained bases: Base1 = iteration19 tabular ensemble (CatBoost + LightGBM with stored ensemble weight and descriptor-based features), Base2 = iteration23 MoLFormer finetuned classifier. Blended output prob1 = w*prob_base1 + (1-w)*prob_base2.
data_representation: No new feature engineering. Base1: reuse iteration 19 tabular ensemble featurization via combine_features.py with descriptor_stats.json (scales descriptors), producing model-specific tabular features for CatBoost and LightGBM; probabilities combined by their stored ensemble weight.

model_architecture: 2-model weighted-average ensemble: Base1 = iteration19 tabular ensemble (CatBoostClassifier + LightGBMClassifier with stored internal catboost_weight from iteration19), Base2 = iteration23 finetuned MoLFormer classifier (tokenizer max_length=256 padding='max_length' truncation=True trust_remote_code=True). Blend probability_1 as w*prob_tab + (1−w)*prob_molf.
data_representation: Reused existing representations. Tabular path: iteration19 feature pipeline via combine_features.py with prefit descriptor scaling stats in descriptor_stats.json; computes concatenated molecular fingerprints/descriptors (same as iteration19) with no new engineering. Deep path: MoLFormer tokenizer from iteration23 with max_length=256, padding='max_length', truncation=True, trust_remote_code=True; embeddings fed to finetuned classifier head (no changes). No modifications to train/validation splits or labels.

model_architecture: Stacking ensemble meta-learner: Base1 = iteration19 tabular ensemble (CatBoost + LightGBM) outputs prob_tab; Base2 = iteration23 MoLFormer finetuned classifier outputs prob_molf; Meta = LogisticRegression (binary) trained on [prob_tab, prob_molf]
data_representation: Re-use iteration 28 representations unchanged: (1) Tabular cheminformatics features computed via combine_features.py with descriptor_stats.json (includes ECFP2 bits, Morgan count fingerprints radius 2 and 3, MACCS keys, and RDKit physicochemical descriptors; missing descriptor values median- imputed; features standardized using scaler fitted on train). (2) Text representation using MolFormer tokenizer ibm-research/MoLFormer-XL-both-10pct with trust_remote_code=True, max_length=256, padding='max_length', truncation=True. Both representations retained for stacking.

model_architecture: LogisticRegression (binary, linear classifier) trained on RDKit Morgan fingerprints (radius=2, 2048-bit)
data_representation: Morgan (ECFP) fingerprints from RDKit: radius=2, n_bits=2048, folded binary bit vectors. Pipeline: read CSV (columns Drug,id[,numeric_label]), convert SMILES to RDKit Mol, compute GetMorganFingerprintAsBitVect, convert to numpy uint8 array shape (2048,), stack to X; preserve id as array; y included if present. Invalid SMILES are skipped with a warning. Output saved via joblib as dict {'X': X, 'id': id, 'y': y (optional)}. Script: representation.py with CLI args --input_csv, --output_pkl, --radius (default 2), --n_bits (default 2048).

model_architecture: RandomForestClassifier with MACCS 167-bit features
data_representation: Added RDKit MACCS (167-bit) featurization. Script representation_maccs.py reads input CSV with columns Drug,id[,numeric_label], converts SMILES to rdMolDescriptors.GetMACCSKeysFingerprint, converts to numpy uint8 array shape (167,), skips and logs invalid SMILES, stacks into X with aligned id (and y if present), and saves joblib dict {'X': X, 'id': id, 'y': y(optional)}. CLI: --input_csv, --output_pkl.

model_architecture: Pipeline(StandardScaler -> LinearSVC(l2, squared_hinge, C=1.0, class_weight='balanced', random_state=42) -> CalibratedClassifierCV(method='sigmoid', cv=3)) on RDKit 2D descriptor features
data_representation: RDKit 2D descriptor featurization via representation_descriptors.py. Script reads input CSV (Drug, id, optional numeric_label), converts SMILES to Mol, computes all rdkit.Chem.Descriptors._descList values, drops descriptor columns with any NaN/Inf or that are constant, replaces residual NaN/Inf with 0, and returns float32 feature matrix X with aligned id (and y if present). Invalid SMILES are logged and kept with NaN values before column filtering. Output saved as joblib dict {X, id, y(optional), feature_names}. CLI: --input_csv, --output_pkl.

model_architecture: LogisticRegression on character-level TF-IDF SMILES
data_representation: Character-level TF-IDF on SMILES: TfidfVectorizer(analyzer='char', ngram_range=(3,5), min_df=2, max_features=50000, lowercase=False, dtype=float32) fitted on train Drug strings. Outputs sparse TF- IDF matrix aligned with ids; saved as joblib dict {'X': sparse_matrix, 'id': id_array, 'y': y_array_if_present} and vectorizer.pkl. Script: representation_tfidf_smiles.py with modes fit (fit+transform, save features & vectorizer) and transform (load vectorizer.pkl, transform new CSV).

model_architecture: HuggingFace AutoModelForSequenceClassification (Roberta-based) using pretrained DeepChem/ChemBERTa-77M-MLM, fine-tuning all layers
data_representation: Tokenize SMILES column `Drug` on the fly using HuggingFace RobertaTokenizerFast from pretrained model DeepChem/ChemBERTa-77M-MLM with settings: padding='max_length', truncation=True, max_length=512. No separate feature file; labels use numeric_label column. Datasets return input_ids, attention_mask, labels (and id for tracking).

model_architecture: XGBoostClassifier on count-based Morgan fingerprints (radius=2, n_bits=2048, useCounts=True, dense float32) with tree_method='gpu_hist' if GPU available, else 'hist'
data_representation: New script representation_morgan_counts.py: generates count-based hashed Morgan fingerprints (radius=2, n_bits=2048, useCounts=True) as dense float32 arrays per SMILES. CLI: python representation_morgan_counts.py input_csv output_pkl [--smiles-col Drug --id-col id --target-col Y --radius 2 --n-bits 2048]. Handles invalid SMILES with warnings; saves joblib dict {'X': X_array, 'id': id_array, 'y': y_array_if_present}.

model_architecture: Ensemble of two XGBoostClassifier (GPU) models: Model A on Morgan count FP radius=2 n_bits=2048; Model B on Morgan count FP radius=3 n_bits=4096; ensemble by averaging positive-class probabilities.
data_representation: Generated count-based Morgan fingerprints using updated representation_morgan_counts.py (zeroes invalid SMILES). Produced four PKLs: morgan_counts_r2_2048_train.pkl, morgan_counts_r2_2048_val.pkl (radius=2, n_bits=2048); morgan_counts_r3_4096_train.pkl, morgan_counts_r3_4096_val.pkl (radius=3, n_bits=4096), with columns mapped from Drug (SMILES), id, numeric_label.

model_architecture: XGBoostClassifier on concatenated features [Morgan2 counts (2048) || Morgan3 counts (4096) || RDKit 2D descriptors (filtered)]; GPU-accelerated (tree_method=gpu_hist, predictor=gpu_predictor)
data_representation: New on-the-fly combined featurizer (combined_featurizer.py): concatenates Morgan count fingerprints (radius=2, 2048 bits, useCounts=True) + Morgan count fingerprints (radius=3, 4096 bits, useCounts=True) + RDKit 2D descriptors filtered on training SMILES (drop NaN/Inf or constant columns). Invalid SMILES yield zero fingerprints and zero descriptors. Featurizer fits on train to select descriptor names; transforms train/val/test with fixed names. Metadata records descriptor names and params; feature order = [morgan2_count_* || morgan3_count_* || descriptors]. No scaling applied.

model_architecture: Bagged XGBoost ensemble (4 binary:logistic models using GPU)
data_representation: Re-used representation_morgan_counts.py from iteration 6 to generate (or reuse) Morgan count

model_architecture: LightGBM ensemble (Model A + Model B) on concatenated Morgan count fingerprints [radius=2, n_bits=2048 || radius=3, n_bits=4096], CPU inference/training
data_representation: Morgan count fingerprints concatenated: (1) radius=2, n_bits=2048 count-based; (2) radius=3, n_bits=4096 count-based. Invalid SMILES mapped to zero vectors. Features concatenated as [r2_2048 || r3_4096] dense arrays. PKLs reused: morgan_counts_r2_2048_train/val.pkl and morgan_counts_r3_4096_train/val.pkl. Targets aligned by id/Drug.

model_architecture: Ensemble: XGBoost GPU Model A + XGBoost GPU Model B + LightGBM CPU Model C on concatenated Morgan count features (r2_2048 || r3_4096).
data_representation: Concatenate precomputed Morgan count fingerprints: radius-2, size 2048 (counts) and radius-3, size 4096 (counts). Use representation_morgan_counts.py to generate/reuse PKLs: morgan_counts_r2_2048_train.pkl, morgan_counts_r2_2048_val.pkl, morgan_counts_r3_4096_train.pkl, morgan_counts_r3_4096_val.pkl. For each molecule SMILES in train/validation, compute RDKit Morgan fingerprints with useCounts=True, nBits=2048 (r=2) and nBits=4096 (r=3). Invalid SMILES yield zero vectors of matching length. Maintain original row order and alignment across splits. Final feature vector per sample = [r2_2048 || r3_4096] (total dim 6144) as dense float32 arrays. Labels unchanged.

model_architecture: Stacking ensemble with four base learners and one meta-learner: (1) XGBoost on Morgan counts r2_2048 with GPU hist; (2) XGBoost on Morgan counts r3_4096 with GPU hist; (3) LightGBM GBDT on concatenated r2||r3 counts; (4) Logistic Regression on char-level TF-IDF SMILES; Meta-learner: Logistic Regression on base-model probabilities.
data_representation: Re-use Morgan count fingerprints and char TF-IDF per instructions. Features: r2_2048 (Morgan radius=2, nBits=2048, useCounts=True), r3_4096 (radius=3, nBits=4096, useCounts=True); invalid SMILES -> zero vectors. TF-IDF: analyzer='char', ngram_range=(3,5), min_df=2, max_features=50000, lowercase=False, dtype=float32; fit on train only, save vectorizer.pkl; transform train/val to sparse matrices. Stack base model outputs later as meta-features.

model_architecture: Stacking ensemble: base learners (1) LightGBM two-model ensemble on concatenated Morgan counts [radius2 2048 || radius3 4096]; (2) XGBoost two-model ensemble on Morgan counts r2/r3 separately; (3) TF-IDF (char 3-5) + Logistic Regression; meta-learner Logistic Regression on stacked base probabilities.
data_representation: Reusing fixed featurizations per instructions: (1) Morgan count fingerprints: radius=2, n_bits=2048, useCounts=True and radius=3, n_bits=4096, useCounts=True; invalid SMILES map to zero vectors. Concatenate r2||r3 for LightGBM; use r2 alone for XGB model A and r3 alone for XGB model B. (2) Char-level TF-IDF on SMILES: analyzer='char', ngram_range=(3,5), min_df=2, max_features=50000, lowercase=False, dtype=float32. Features generated on-the-fly for train/val/test; no new split created.

model_architecture: Stacking ensemble: 4 base learners + meta-learner. Base models: LightGBM_A and LightGBM_B on concatenated Morgan count fingerprints [r2||r3]; XGBoost_A on r2; XGBoost_B on r3. Meta-learner: LogisticRegression on OOF base probabilities.
data_representation: Use dual Morgan count fingerprints generated on-the-fly from SMILES column `Drug`: r2 (radius=2, n_bits=2048, useCounts=True) and r3 (radius=3, n_bits=4096, useCounts=True). Concatenate r2||r3 for LightGBM models; use r2 alone for XGBoost_A; r3 alone for XGBoost_B. Invalid SMILES -> zero vectors for both radii. Preserve feature ordering (r2 bits first, then r3 bits) across train/val/test. Labels taken from column `Y` (numeric).

model_architecture: Four models: (1) XGBoost binary:logistic on r2 Morgan count fingerprints (radius=2, 2048 bits, useCounts=True) with GPU tree_method=gpu_hist; (2) XGBoost binary:logistic on r3 Morgan count fingerprints (radius=3, 4096 bits, useCounts=True) with GPU tree_method=gpu_hist; (3) LightGBM GBDT on concatenated r2||r3 (6144 dims) configuration A; (4) LightGBM GBDT on concatenated r2||r3 (6144 dims) configuration B. Ensemble via weighted average over per-model probabilities (weights tuned on val simplex grid).
data_representation: Reused Morgan count fingerprints from iteration 6/10. Generate r2 (radius=2, n_bits=2048, useCounts=True) and r3 (radius=3, n_bits=4096, useCounts=True) using representation_morgan_counts.py. Invalid SMILES → zero vectors. For LightGBM models concatenate r2 || r3 (dimension 2048+4096=6144, r2 bits first). For XGB_r2 use only r2; for XGB_r3 use only r3. Preserve this ordering across train/val/test.

model_architecture: Ensemble of five tree-based models: three XGBoost classifiers (r2, r3, r4 slices) using
data_representation: On-the-fly RDKit Morgan count fingerprints. For each SMILES: generate three vectors—r2 (radius=2, n_bits=2048, useCounts=True), r3 (radius=3, n_bits=4096, useCounts=True), r4 (radius=4, n_bits=4096, useCounts=True). Invalid SMILES -> zero vectors. For LightGBM models, concatenate in fixed order [r2 || r3 || r4]. For XGBoost models, use only the designated slice: XGB_r2 uses r2 only, XGB_r3 uses r3 only, XGB_r4 uses r4 only. No persisted PKL; featurize inside train/inference scripts. Preserve original row order and ids.

model_architecture: Ensemble on MolFormer CLS embeddings: LightGBMClassifier (CPU) + XGBoostClassifier (GPU, gpu_hist), averaged probabilities.
data_representation: Generated MolFormer CLS embeddings using ibm-research/MoLFormer-XL-both-10pct (AutoTokenizer/AutoModel with trust_remote_code). Tokenized SMILES column `Drug` with padding='max_length', truncation=True, max_length=256; batch size 12 on GPU, model.eval() with torch.no_grad(). CLS token embedding (last_hidden_state[:,0,:]) collected, cast to float32 CPU numpy. Handled invalid SMILES by substituting empty strings. Saved joblib PKLs: molformer_train.pkl and molformer_val.pkl with keys {'X': embeddings array, 'id': ids, 'y': labels if present}.

model_architecture: Stacking ensemble: 7 base models + logistic regression meta-learner. Base models: (1) XGBoost on r2 Morgan counts; (2) XGBoost on r3 counts; (3) XGBoost on r4 counts; (4) LightGBM model A on concatenated [r2||r3||r4] counts; (5) LightGBM model B on concatenated [r2||r3||r4] counts; (6) LightGBM on MolFormer embeddings; (7) XGBoost on MolFormer embeddings. Meta-learner: LogisticRegression (liblinear) on OOF probabilities.
data_representation: On-the-fly molecular featurization. For each SMILES (column Drug): generate three Morgan count vectors using RDKit (invalid SMILES -> all zeros): r2 (radius=2, n_bits=2048, useCounts=True), r3 (radius=3, n_bits=4096, useCounts=True), r4 (radius=4, n_bits=4096, useCounts=True). Concatenate [r2||r3||r4] (total 101... wait compute: 2048+4096+4096=101... hold up compute) for LightGBM models; use individual slices (r2 only, r3 only, r4 only) for respective XGBoost models. Additionally, use precomputed MolFormer embeddings (CLS token from ibm-research/MoLFormer-XL-both-10pct, max_length=256, batch_size≈12, float32) stored in molformer_train.pkl/molformer_val.pkl with keys {'X','id','y'} aligned to train/validation CSVs. If missing, regenerate embeddings accordingly. No scaling/normalization applied to counts or embeddings; keep native counts/float32.

model_architecture: RandomForestRegressor on 2048-bit Morgan fingerprints (radius 2)
data_representation: Basic molecular fingerprints. Each SMILES in column `Drug` is converted to an RDKit Morgan fingerprint with radius=2 and n_bits=2048 (bit vector). Invalid SMILES fallback to all-zero vector. Features stored as NumPy arrays: train_features.npy, val_features.npy with shapes (582, 2048) and (146, 2048). Corresponding targets/ids saved in train_targets.npy, val_targets.npy, train_ids.npy, val_ids.npy.

model_architecture: GradientBoostingRegressor (scikit-learn)
data_representation: MACCS 166-bit binary fingerprints computed with RDKit for SMILES; invalid SMILES mapped to all-zero vector. Saved features: train_features_maccs.npy (582x166), val_features_maccs.npy (146x166); targets and ids saved as train_targets.npy, val_targets.npy, train_ids.npy, val_ids.npy aligned to iteration 0 split.

model_architecture: Scikit-learn Pipeline: [SimpleImputer(strategy='median'), StandardScaler(), ElasticNet(regression)]
data_representation: RDKit 2D descriptor set (217 standard numeric descriptors via rdMolDescriptors/Descriptors) computed for SMILES in column `Drug`; invalid SMILES -> NaN. Dropped all-NaN or invariant columns (std<=1e-12) jointly on train+val, retaining 210 descriptors. Saved artifacts aligned to split v1: train_features_desc.npy (582x210), val_features_desc.npy (146x210), train_targets.npy, val_targets.npy, train_ids.npy, val_ids.npy, descriptor_names_desc.json (kept column order).

model_architecture: Pipeline(StandardScaler + Ridge)
data_representation: RDKit Morgan count fingerprints (radius=2, n_bits=2048, useCounts=True, includeChirality=False). Invalid SMILES -> all-zero vector.
